gloss: lover of alcohol; lover of spicy food

definitions.gloss: a person who prefers alcohol to sweets; a drinker
definitions.explanation: traditionally, someone who enjoys drinking alcohol rather than eating sweet things

definitions.gloss: a person who loves spicy food
definitions.explanation: in modern usage, someone who enjoys spicy or hot-flavored foods

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{辛党|からとう}で{毎晩|まいばん}{晩酌|ばんしゃく}をする。
examples.english: My grandfather is a drinker and has a drink every evening.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{辛党|からとう}だから、{甘|あま}いものはあまり{食|た}べない。
examples.english: I prefer alcohol to sweets, so I don't eat many sweet things.

examples.japanese: {辛党|からとう}なので{激辛|げきから}ラーメンに{挑戦|ちょうせん}した。
examples.english: Since I love spicy food, I tried the super-spicy ramen.

examples.japanese: {辛党|からとう}の{友人|ゆうじん}のために{辛|から}い{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made spicy food for my friend who loves spicy things.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{辛党|からとう}だから、どんな{料理|りょうり}にも{唐辛子|とうがらし}をかける。
examples.english: He loves spicy food, so he puts chili on everything.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{辛党|からとう}に{人気|にんき}のカレー{専門店|せんもんてん}だ。
examples.english: This restaurant is a curry specialty shop popular with spicy food lovers.

notes:
FORMATION:
{辛|から}い (spicy; sake-loving) + {党|とう} (party, group) → spicy/sake party

ORIGINAL MEANING:
Historically, {辛|から}い in this context meant "not sweet" rather than "spicy." The word referred to people who preferred {酒|さけ} (sake) over {甘|あま}いもの (sweets). This is why {辛党|からとう} was the opposite of {甘党|あまとう}.

MODERN SHIFT:
Today, many people interpret {辛党|からとう} as "spicy food lover" due to the common meaning of {辛|から}い (spicy). Both usages are now accepted.

CONTRAST:
- {甘党|あまとう} (sweet tooth) - prefers sweets
- {辛党|からとう} (drinker/spice lover) - prefers alcohol or spicy food

RELATED TERMS:
- {激辛|げきから} (extremely spicy)
- {辛|から}いもの{好|ず}き (lover of spicy things)
- {下戸|げこ} (person who can't drink alcohol)
